item.description:

3️⃣ Supported single leg squat pulse x 15

item.title: No Gym? No Problem! 3 Exercises to Tone Your Calves at Home
item.description: Strengthen and tone your calves with these 3 simple yet powerful exercises that require no equipment. Aim for 12-15 reps and 3 sets, squeezing at the top to fully engage your muscles. Focus on quality over quantity—slow, deliberate movements create constant tension, making each rep more effective. Challenge yourself by slowing down on the eccentric phase (lowering). Achieve stronger, sculpted calves without stepping foot in a gym! #CalfWorkout #HomeFitness #NoGymWorkout #LegTraining

item.title: Buttocks VS Outer Thighs VS Inner Thighs💦
item.description: ➡️Buttocks: The glutes are intensely engaged, especially during the lifting phase. Wider stances, such as in sumo squats, increase activation of the glutes. ➡️Inner Thighs (Adductors): The adductors, located on the inner thigh, are less stressed in standard squats. Position with wider legs or sumo squats can intensify their activation. ➡️External Thighs (Abductors): The muscles on the outer thighs help stabilize the hips and legs. Narrower positions or exercises that involve lateral movements emphasize the work of the abductors. By adjusting the type of squat and leg position, you can target these muscle groups differently, optimizing the workout for your specific goals. Save the post for later an

item.title: CURTSY Lunge vs REVERSE Lunge🤝🏻
item.description: CURTSY Lunge vs REVERSE Lunge🤝🏻 Reverse Lunge👇🏻 More hip-dominant (glutenfocused) than forward lunges, but still works quads ✅ Step straight back, anding on the ball of rear foot. ✅ As you step back, bend your lead knee slightly and start lowering your elevation the moment your rear foot touches the ground. ✅ With roughly 80% of weight on your front foot, 20% on rear, lower rear knee to ground While leaning forward slightly ✅ Immediately reverse the movement by driving through front heel and stand upright! Curtsy Lunge👇🏻 the aim of the curtsy lunges is to increase the stretch of the glutes in that lengthened position. It’s a great exercise for the glute max AND medius and when done correctly. ✅ Shift weight onto one leg and swing other leg behind your grounded leg

item.title: Stronger Knees Exercises
item.description: Knee discomfort is often linked to weak supporting muscles—not just the knees themselves. When the quads, calves, glutes, and hip muscles aren’t doing their job, the knees take on extra stress during daily movement and workouts. These 6 exercises target the muscles that help support and stabilize the knee joint, including: ✔ Quadriceps ✔ Hip flexors ✔ Glutes Building strength around the knees can improve stability, reduce pressure, and help you move with more confidence and control. Strong support = stronger knees. item.title: Leg Day training - 5 variations of leg poses to work the entire lower body
item.description: Leg Day training - 5 variations of leg poses to work the entire lower body Leg Position Variations - 5 Ways to Hit All Lower Body 1 Deficit Squat (Deficit Squat) Stand up on pancakes/platform and squat deeper + main focus on quadriceps. 2 Wide Squat (Wide Squat) - Legs wider shoulders, knees push out + Adductors + inner part of the quadriceps (Inner Quads) are activated. 3 Narrow Squat (Narrow Squat) - Narrow leg placement → emphasis on the outer head of the quadriceps (Vastus Lateralis). 4.Bulgarian falls (Bulgarian Split Squat) Rear leg on support, front - working + powerful load on the glutes and quadriceps (Quads) Forward inclination of the body + greater emphasis on the buttocks. - Vertical housing + greater emphasis on quadriceps
item.content:encoded: Leg Day training - 5 variations of leg poses to work the entire lower body Leg Position Variations - 5 Ways to Hit All Lower Body 1 Deficit Squat (Deficit Squat) Stand up on pancakes/platform and squat deeper + main focus on quadriceps. 2 Wide Squat (Wide Squat) - Legs wider shoulders, knees push out + Adductors + inner part of the quadriceps (Inner Quads) are activated. 3 Narrow Squat (Narrow Squat) - Narrow leg placement → emphasis on the outer head of the quadriceps (Vastus Lateralis). 4.Bulgarian falls (Bulgarian Split Squat) Rear leg on support, front - working + powerful load on the glutes and quadriceps (Quads) Forward inclination of the body + greater emphasis on the buttocks. - Vertical housing + greater emphasis on quadriceps

item.title: Powerful Glutes: Strength Training for Results
30 min dumbbell only LOWER BODY workout 🔥
item.description:
30 min lower body 🥵🔥 I had to share this lower body workout from Monday because it was so good and deserved a permanent spot on the feed!
⚠️FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTION⚠️ “what does a workout from inside @movementwithjulie weekly workouts look like?”
➡️ all “no bench “ and low impact” or “bodyweight” alternate exercises are inside the app! 📲
⬇️ Here’s what the GIANT CIRCUIT looked like ⬇️
12 ES double pulse split squats • 1 min AMRAP alt shallow curtsy lunges • 10 ES single leg deadlift on bench • 1 min AMRAP pilé squat to pulse • 10 ES side leg hip abduction
12 slow DB hamstring curls on floor
REST for 2 mins…REPEAT 3x
It should take you right around 28-32 mins to complete 💪🏼🔥
NOT having a plan was one of the MOST detrimental things I did in my fitness journey. ⁣
